svg.title: JMR computer architecture: programs, Toolbox, system and hardware
svg.desc: Read from top to bottom: Finder and applications call shared software and system services, which run on one native JavaScript CPU and reusable FPGA engines. Toolbox calls are grouped by purpose. SYSTEM.SYS is data, separate from executable TOOLBOX.ROM. Current development source, November 4, 2026; board qualification is separate.
svg.text: Macintosh-inspired organization • one native JavaScript CPU • clear ownership at every layer
DEVELOPMENT SOURCE · 4 NOV 2026 Run77d/e/f include bitmap transport now; whole-board qualification pending.
Programs decide behavior → shared routines → system services → FPGA mechanisms
HTML / JavaScript → compiled JSH · same VM as Finder
DESKTOP.FDR on a flat FAT root
File / Edit / View / Special menus; native menu UI still draws the bar.
One active program; Finder executable + arena can be parked in DDR.
Call shared code or existing native APIs
TOOLBOX.ROM · shared JavaScript instructions; globals, constants and heap state belong to each application.
Software UI is cooperative: feed events → handle command/result → draw content + UI → present the frame.
Existing native APIs + controllers in RTL; this is broader than SYSTEM.SYS.
Validate ROM / SYS / JSH; LOAD / RUN
Finder FS → storage engine → FAT disk
Finder + unconverted apps keep this path
Local UI memories + retained DDR snapshot
tbResources → app data; tbText uses glyphs
Software dialog layout stays in Toolbox code
Same CPU; reusable hardware executes the work
The .bit defines these mechanisms. Changing a JavaScript program or supported resource does not redefine the FPGA.
USB keyboard J15; PS/2 JA + JC
One VM and one drawing canvas
Programs: HTML → JSH Shared code: TOOLBOX.ROM Shared data: SYSTEM.SYS
Boot: validate + commit ROM → validate + commit SYS → load Finder. Bad shared files use factory / cold-start defaults.
Software algorithms: update ROM + relink clients. New hardware access / formats / capacity: Vivado + new .bit.
Memory detail: memory-map.svg · 160 KiB Finder cache + 72 KiB parked arena + 24 KiB SYS staging; allocation unchanged.
Layer arrows show responsibility, not a mandatory route: apps can call native APIs directly; legacy UI is an existing parallel path.
Sources: Finder / Toolbox JavaScript, RTL, RESIDENT_TOOLBOX.md, TOOLBOX_API.md. Release status: TOOLBOX_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md.
